# dsh-power-monitor
**Real-time power draw in your DeepSeek Harness sidebar** — watts first, then CPU, memory, temperatu
re and fan speed, right above your account row.
一个 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：把你 Mac 的**实时功耗**放到侧栏底部（账号行上方），顺带显示 CPU、内存、温度与风扇转速。
> Why power? Watts are the single number that tells you whether something is quietly burning your ba
ttery — a 0.2 W idle and a 22 W runaway look identical in every CPU-percentage widget.

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The client polls the host route every 2 seconds. Nothing is sent over the network.
### Why a root daemon?
Reading SMC (fan RPM, die temperatures) and `powermetrics` (power draw) both require root on Apple S
ilicon. There is no userland API for them — every macOS monitor that shows these values either ships
a privileged helper or asks for a password each time.
If you would rather not install a daemon, skip step 2: the widget falls back to CPU and memory, whic
h need no privileges.
## Metrics & thresholds
| Metric | Source | 🟢 | 🟡 | 🟠 | 🔴 |

| CPU | Mach `host_statistics` (400 ms delta) | <30% | 30–60% | 60–85% | >85% |
| MEM | `vm_stat` (a

ctive + wired + compressed) | <60% | 60–80% | 80–90% | >90% |
| TEMP | SMC `Tp*` sensors, max | <55°
cs` cpu+gpu+ane | <4 W | 4–12 W | 12–25 W | >25 W |
The status dot takes the **worst** of CPU / TEMP / PWR.
`FAN` showing **0 rpm** is normal: Apple silicon stops the fan below its start threshold (about 50–6
0 °C on this machine, minimum spin-up 2317 rpm).
## Known limitations

- **Fanless Macs** (MacBook Air) have no `F0Ac`; the FAN cell stays empty.
- **Temperature keys** ar
e probed from a list of known Apple silicon keys (`Tp00`…`Tp0g`, `Tg0*`). Other SoCs may use differe

nt names and report nothing — the card degrades gracefully rather than showing wrong numbers.
- **Bu

ndled binary is arm64 only.** Building for Intel needs a universal build; see `helper/smc.swift`.
-
**Power is noisy.** A 250 ms `powermetrics` window sampled every 2 s can differ from what another to

ol shows at the same instant. The client applies a 3-sample median for display only.
- Relies on DSH
's internal slot name `sidebar.footer.action`; a DSH update may rename it.

## Privacy

- No network requests leave your machine.
- The daemon writes exactly one file: `/tmp/dsh-power-moni

tor.json`, world-readable, overwritten every ~2 s.
- Error output goes to `/var/log/dsh-power-monito

world-readable, overwritten every ~2 s.
- Error output goes to `/var/log/dsh-power-monitor.err.log`.
